propositions: Live multi-project rehearsal must run against ephemeral Jira DC instance with dynamically provisioned scratch projects rather than fixed Cloud projects to model cross-project isolation, per-project key allocation, and fail-closed behavior for unknown projects
The inbound fetcher must handle non-existent configured project keys as fail-closed errors (rejecting the entire pass) rather than returning empty, matching real Jira behavior
Outbound mutations must be preview-gated to verify each planned change targets only its intended project with zero cross-project contamination before sync applies changes
Throwaway scratch projects must be created per run with random RBJ-prefixed keys and fully cleaned up (404 verified) on all exit paths including mid-scenario failures
The rehearsal must run in the jira-dc-harness CI job as a reproducible, CI-verified green run on every build with all nine acceptance criteria validated
Test preconditions around --only/--except resolution and mapping commit durability must be fixed to unblock the live DC scenarios
